payload.title: Make Cyclotron a versioned scorecard-first single-page application
payload.description: Deliver one coherent app for versioned scorecards containing versioned classifiers, interactive labeling and frozen-label optimization replay. Replace standalone Classifiers navigation with Scorecards and nested classifier configuration. Use the existing full-screen timeline and labeling layouts as the permanent app layouts; remove fullscreen controls. Integrate history and live optimizer activity with app drawers. Record and visualize per-classifier calibrated confidence alongside recall, precision and accuracy. Preserve existing labels, explanations, item identities and immutable run evidence. Implementation must follow the child issues, specs first and fake clients; no DSPy, no new engine, no fabricated labels, no implicit paid replay. Existing draft versioning/calibration code is partial work, not acceptance. Completion requires browser verification including iPad-sized labeling and timeline playback.
